import MilneLib.Sheaf.SemilinearAlgebraModules
import Mathlib.RingTheory.Flat.FaithfullyFlat.Basic

/-!
# Base change of invariant modules

An equivariant map that presents a module by extension of scalars induces the
corresponding extension of scalars on invariant modules. This applies to the
restriction maps of a quasicoherent equivariant sheaf on affine opens.
-/

set_option autoImplicit false

universe u v w w' w''

open scoped TensorProduct

namespace MilneLib.GaloisDescent.SemilinearAction

variable (K L : Type u) [Field K] [Field L] [Algebra K L]
variable (R T : Type v) [CommRing R] [CommRing T]
  [Algebra K R] [Algebra L R] [IsScalarTower K L R]
  [MulSemiringAction (L ≃ₐ[K] L) R] [IsSemilinear K L R]
  [Algebra K T] [Algebra L T] [IsScalarTower K L T]
  [MulSemiringAction (L ≃ₐ[K] L) T] [IsSemilinear K L T]
  [Algebra R T]

variable [Algebra (FixedPoints.subalgebra K R (L ≃ₐ[K] L))
    (FixedPoints.subalgebra K T (L ≃ₐ[K] L))]
  [IsScalarTower (FixedPoints.subalgebra K R (L ≃ₐ[K] L))
    (FixedPoints.subalgebra K T (L ≃ₐ[K] L)) T]
variable (M : Type w) [AddCommGroup M] [Module K M] [Module L M]
  [Module R M] [IsScalarTower K L M] [IsScalarTower L R M]
  [IsScalarTower K R M] [DistribMulAction (L ≃ₐ[K] L) M]
  [SMulDistribClass (L ≃ₐ[K] L) R M]
variable (N : Type w') [AddCommGroup N] [Module K N] [Module L N]
  [Module R N] [Module T N] [IsScalarTower K L N]
  [IsScalarTower L T N] [IsScalarTower K T N] [IsScalarTower R T N]
  [IsScalarTower (FixedPoints.subalgebra K R (L ≃ₐ[K] L))
    (FixedPoints.subalgebra K T (L ≃ₐ[K] L)) N]
  [DistribMulAction (L ≃ₐ[K] L) N]
  [SMulDistribClass (L ≃ₐ[K] L) T N]

/-- The ordinary extension-of-scalars comparison associated to a module map. -/
noncomputable def moduleBaseChangeMap (f : M →ₗ[R] N) :
    T ⊗[R] M →ₗ[T] N :=
  TensorProduct.AlgebraTensorModule.lift (LinearMap.toSpanSingleton T _ f)

@[simp]
theorem moduleBaseChangeMap_tmul (f : M →ₗ[R] N) (t : T) (m : M) :
    moduleBaseChangeMap R T M N f (t ⊗ₜ m) = t • f m := rfl

variable (P : Type w'') [AddCommGroup P] [Module T P] [Module R P]
  [IsScalarTower R T P]

/-- Extending the composite with a `T`-linear target map agrees with applying
that target map after the scalar-extension comparison. -/
theorem moduleBaseChangeMap_comp (f : M →ₗ[R] N) (g : N →ₗ[T] P) :
    moduleBaseChangeMap R T M P (g.restrictScalars R ∘ₗ f) =
      g.comp (moduleBaseChangeMap R T M N f) := by
  apply LinearMap.ext
  intro z
  induction z using TensorProduct.induction_on with
  | zero => simp
  | tmul t m =>
      simp only [moduleBaseChangeMap_tmul, LinearMap.comp_apply,
        LinearMap.restrictScalars_apply, map_smul]
  | add x y hx hy => simp only [map_add, hx, hy]

section Tower

variable (U : Type v) [CommRing U] [Algebra R U] [Algebra T U]
  [IsScalarTower R T U] [Module U P]
  [IsScalarTower R U P] [IsScalarTower T U P]

/-- Base-change comparisons compose through a tower of coefficient rings,
after the canonical cancellation of successive tensor products. -/
theorem moduleBaseChangeMap_comp_cancelBaseChange
    (f : M →ₗ[R] N) (g : N →ₗ[T] P) :
    (moduleBaseChangeMap R U M P ((g.restrictScalars R).comp f)).comp
        (TensorProduct.AlgebraTensorModule.cancelBaseChange R T U U M).toLinearMap =
      (moduleBaseChangeMap T U N P g).comp
        ((moduleBaseChangeMap R T M N f).baseChange U) := by
  apply LinearMap.ext
  intro z
  induction z using TensorProduct.induction_on with
  | zero => simp
  | tmul a x =>
      induction x using TensorProduct.induction_on with
      | zero => simp
      | tmul t m =>
          simp only [LinearMap.comp_apply]
          change moduleBaseChangeMap R U M P ((g.restrictScalars R).comp f)
              (TensorProduct.AlgebraTensorModule.cancelBaseChange R T U U M
                (a ⊗ₜ[T] (t ⊗ₜ[R] m))) = _
          rw [TensorProduct.AlgebraTensorModule.cancelBaseChange_tmul]
          simp only [moduleBaseChangeMap_tmul, LinearMap.baseChange_tmul,
            map_smul]
          change (t • a) • g (f m) = a • t • g (f m)
          rw [← IsScalarTower.algebraMap_smul U t a, smul_assoc,
            smul_comm (algebraMap T U t) a,
            IsScalarTower.algebraMap_smul U t (g (f m))]
      | add x y hx hy => simp only [TensorProduct.tmul_add, map_add, hx, hy]
  | add x y hx hy => simp only [map_add, hx, hy]

end Tower

/-- Restriction of an equivariant map to invariant vectors, allowing different
coefficient rings on source and target. -/
def invariantModuleScalarMap (f : M →ₗ[R] N)
    (hf : ∀ (g : L ≃ₐ[K] L) (m : M), f (g • m) = g • f m) :
    invariantModule K L R M →ₗ[FixedPoints.subalgebra K R (L ≃ₐ[K] L)]
      invariantModule K L T N where
  toFun m := ⟨f m, fun g => by rw [← hf, m.2 g]⟩
  map_add' _ _ := Subtype.ext (map_add f _ _)
  map_smul' r m := Subtype.ext (map_smul f (r : R) (m : M))

/-- The canonical comparison for extension of scalars on invariant modules. -/
noncomputable def invariantModuleBaseChangeMap (f : M →ₗ[R] N)
    (hf : ∀ (g : L ≃ₐ[K] L) (m : M), f (g • m) = g • f m) :
    (FixedPoints.subalgebra K T (L ≃ₐ[K] L))
      ⊗[FixedPoints.subalgebra K R (L ≃ₐ[K] L)] invariantModule K L R M
      →ₗ[FixedPoints.subalgebra K T (L ≃ₐ[K] L)]
      invariantModule K L T N :=
  TensorProduct.AlgebraTensorModule.lift
    (LinearMap.toSpanSingleton (FixedPoints.subalgebra K T (L ≃ₐ[K] L)) _
      (invariantModuleScalarMap K L R T M N f hf))

omit [Algebra R T]
  [IsScalarTower (FixedPoints.subalgebra K R (L ≃ₐ[K] L))
    (FixedPoints.subalgebra K T (L ≃ₐ[K] L)) T]
  [Module K M] [Module L M] [IsScalarTower K L M]
  [IsScalarTower L R M] [IsScalarTower K R M]
  [Module K N] [Module L N] [IsScalarTower K L N]
  [IsScalarTower L T N] [IsScalarTower K T N] [IsScalarTower R T N] in
@[simp]
theorem invariantModuleBaseChangeMap_tmul (f : M →ₗ[R] N)
    (hf : ∀ (g : L ≃ₐ[K] L) (m : M), f (g • m) = g • f m)
    (t : FixedPoints.subalgebra K T (L ≃ₐ[K] L)) (m : invariantModule K L R M) :
    (invariantModuleBaseChangeMap K L R T M N f hf (t ⊗ₜ m) : N) =
      (t : T) • f m := rfl

variable [FiniteDimensional K L] [IsGalois K L]

/-- If an equivariant map presents the target as a scalar extension, its
invariant comparison is bijective. -/
theorem invariantModuleBaseChangeMap_bijective (f : M →ₗ[R] N)
    (hf : ∀ (g : L ≃ₐ[K] L) (m : M), f (g • m) = g • f m)
    (h : Function.Bijective (moduleBaseChangeMap R T M N f)) :
    Function.Bijective (invariantModuleBaseChangeMap K L R T M N f hf) := by
  let c := invariantModuleBaseChangeMap K L R T M N f hf
  let eR := moduleDescentEquiv K L R M
  let eT := moduleDescentEquiv K L T N
  let a := TensorProduct.AlgebraTensorModule.cancelBaseChange
    (FixedPoints.subalgebra K R (L ≃ₐ[K] L))
    (FixedPoints.subalgebra K T (L ≃ₐ[K] L)) T T
    (invariantModule K L R M)
  let b := TensorProduct.AlgebraTensorModule.cancelBaseChange
    (FixedPoints.subalgebra K R (L ≃ₐ[K] L)) R T T
    (invariantModule K L R M)
  let d := (a.trans b.symm).trans (eR.baseChange R T)
  have hc : eT.toLinearMap.comp (c.baseChange T) =
      (moduleBaseChangeMap R T M N f).comp d.toLinearMap := by
    ext m
    simp [c, d, a, b, eR, eT, LinearMap.comp_apply]
  have hc' : Function.Bijective (c.baseChange T) := by
    have hh : Function.Bijective (eT.toLinearMap.comp (c.baseChange T)) := by
      rw [hc]
      exact h.comp d.bijective
    exact (eT.bijective.of_comp_iff' (c.baseChange T)).mp hh
  letI := faithfullyFlat_fixedPoints K L T
  exact (Module.FaithfullyFlat.lTensor_bijective_iff_bijective
    (FixedPoints.subalgebra K T (L ≃ₐ[K] L)) T c).mp hc'

/-- Invariant modules commute with an equivariant scalar extension. -/
noncomputable def invariantModuleBaseChangeEquiv (f : M →ₗ[R] N)
    (hf : ∀ (g : L ≃ₐ[K] L) (m : M), f (g • m) = g • f m)
    (h : Function.Bijective (moduleBaseChangeMap R T M N f)) :
    (FixedPoints.subalgebra K T (L ≃ₐ[K] L))
      ⊗[FixedPoints.subalgebra K R (L ≃ₐ[K] L)] invariantModule K L R M
      ≃ₗ[FixedPoints.subalgebra K T (L ≃ₐ[K] L)] invariantModule K L T N :=
  LinearEquiv.ofBijective (invariantModuleBaseChangeMap K L R T M N f hf)
    (invariantModuleBaseChangeMap_bijective K L R T M N f hf h)

@[simp]
theorem invariantModuleBaseChangeEquiv_tmul (f : M →ₗ[R] N)
    (hf : ∀ (g : L ≃ₐ[K] L) (m : M), f (g • m) = g • f m)
    (h : Function.Bijective (moduleBaseChangeMap R T M N f))
    (t : FixedPoints.subalgebra K T (L ≃ₐ[K] L)) (m : invariantModule K L R M) :
    (invariantModuleBaseChangeEquiv K L R T M N f hf h (t ⊗ₜ m) : N) =
      (t : T) • f m := rfl

end MilneLib.GaloisDescent.SemilinearAction
